subject: non-linear progression and unlocking cars
author: ZombieTron
body:
Although you will roughly unlock the cars at the same time due to the progression of the game I don't think the cars will unlock at the same time for everybody. At least it didn't seem too, I'm pretty sure I was unlocking cars in a different order to Xandu.

The cars will unlock within the same License tho.

Operation Burnout's Car List states an amount of events to unlock the vehicles, but I don't think this will be the same for everybody as I think it depends what type of events you are doing as well.

The Burnout Paradise Wiki car list also states the number of events needed.

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Update: Burnout Paradise Car List
author: Xandu
body:
I originally made this list the day after I got the game which was 2 days before release. At that time I did not have the stats for the sponsor cars so I decided not to include them. We know have complete information about most of the cars and because of that this list needed an update 🙂

The car list has been updated with the new cars in Cagney + all the "verified" sponsor cars.

Other cars like the Marble Car or The Yodobashi Custom have not been included as they are not official cars in the game.

Stats for a couple of the cars in Cagney are still unknown but we will update these as soon as we have them verified. I have not updated the pdf file but will do so when I have the missing stats in place.

-- The Creator --

subject: We need to update the list
author: ZombieTron
body:
As the graduation weekend idea has flown out the window along with loads of other Paradise plans that CG once had.

The Calander that was downloaded as part of the Cagney update was supposed to have specific dates where you could play to unlock cars, but this idea was not very popular as most people don't like having to play at a certain time, or they may not have been able to play at that time for whatever reason. CG seem to have abandoned this completely now, although as updates are still to come, you never know the calander may have a purpose yet...
